title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Denison University
description: Granville's quiet village charm meets late-night student life through on-campus hubs and nearby Newark essentials that keep the Hill fueled after hours.

cards.title: Slayter Market
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Level, Slayter Union
cards.notes: Visit the Broad Street Grill inside for burgers and wraps. It is the primary late-night food hub on the Hill during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: The central on-campus late-night dining destination featuring the Broad Street Grill.
cards.evidence_claim: Slayter Market features the Broad Street Grill and is a key campus dining location for students.
cards.access_notes: Open late during the academic semester; check the Grubhub app for current nightly closing times.

cards.title: Common Grounds
cards.subtitle: Slayter Hall Student Union
cards.notes: Grab a coffee or frozen drink for late-night study sessions. This cafe provides a social atmosphere in the heart of the student union.
cards.short_summary: A student-centric coffee shop located within the Slayter Hall Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: Common Grounds is located on the campus center level of Slayter Union and offers coffee options.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; typically open for evening study and social hours.

cards.title: The Nest
cards.subtitle: Slayter Hall Student Union
cards.notes: Order flatbreads and specialty items through the Grubhub app. It serves as a popular alternative for evening meals on campus.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dining spot in Slayter Hall known for flatbreads and mobile ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nest is located in Slayter Hall and offers flatbreads and mobile ordering via Grubhub.
cards.access_notes: Check the Denison Dining website for specific evening hours during the school year.

cards.title: Late-Night Breakfast at Huffman
cards.subtitle: The Table at Huffman
cards.notes: Attend scheduled late-night breakfast events for food and games. These university-sponsored events are a staple of finals week and special occasions.
cards.short_summary: A recurring university event featuring breakfast food and social activities late at night.
cards.evidence_claim: Denison Dining hosts Late-night Breakfast events at Huffman Dining Hall until 12 am.
cards.access_notes: Typically held from 10 pm to 12 am on specific event dates.

cards.title: Late-Night Breakfast at Curtis
cards.subtitle: The Table at Curtis
cards.notes: Join the community for late-night pancakes and board games. This event provides a high-energy break from late-night studying.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night breakfast event held at Curtis Dining Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Curtis Dining Hall hosts Late Night Breakfast events from 10 pm to 12 am.
cards.source_title: Late Night Breakfast - Denison Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Event-based; usually scheduled during exam periods or special campus weekends.

cards.title: Whit's Frozen Custard
cards.subtitle: 226 E Broadway
cards.notes: Walk down the hill for a signature 'Whitser' or a scoop of the flavor of the week. It is a quintessential Granville evening tradition.
cards.short_summary: The original location of the famous frozen custard shop, located in downtown Granville.
cards.evidence_claim: Whit's Frozen Custard in Granville is the original home and is open daily until 9 pm.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 9 pm; often has lines of students on warm evenings.

cards.title: Day Y Noche
cards.subtitle: 134 E Broadway
cards.notes: Stop by for nachos or quesadillas in the heart of the village. It is one of the few downtown spots serving food until 9 pm or later.
cards.short_summary: A local Mexican restaurant in downtown Granville popular for evening meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Day Y Noche is open until 9 pm most nights and 10 pm on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 9 pm Monday-Thursday and 10 pm on Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell (Newark)
cards.subtitle: 1091 N 21st St
cards.notes: Drive to nearby Newark for a late-night taco run. The drive-thru remains open well past midnight for those with off-campus transportation.
cards.short_summary: A reliable late-night fast food option located a short drive from campus in Newark.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 1091 N 21st St in Newark has drive-thru hours until 1 am daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Newark, OH - 1091 N 21st St
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 1 am daily; dining room closes earlier at midnight.

cards.title: Sheetz (Newark)
cards.subtitle: 815 N 21st St
cards.notes: Order Made-To-Order snacks at any hour of the night. This 24/7 spot is the ultimate destination for students needing food in the early morning.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and eatery in Newark frequently visited by Denison students.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheetz provides Made-To-Order food and beverages 24/7/365.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: CVS Pharmacy
cards.subtitle: 200 E Broadway
cards.notes: Pick up snacks, drinks, or basic groceries until 10 pm. It is the most convenient spot in the village for late-evening essentials.
cards.short_summary: A pharmacy and convenience store in downtown Granville open until late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The CVS at 200 E. Broadway in Granville is open until 10 pm daily.
cards.source_title: CVS Pharmacy at 200 E. Broadway Granville, OH 43023
cards.access_notes: Store and photo services are open until 10 pm; pharmacy hours are shorter.
